label: D1 after a rare-rewarded a1 trial (a1 -> S2 rewarded), late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), only when the reward input is 1, and about 91% of its mass falls where the previous trial was a1 with a rare transition to S2 that was rewarded. It essentially never fires after a2 or after common transitions (3 of 2952 activations). It is also gated by episode time: it never fires before ep_trial ~55, and the rate rises through trials 60-90. Adding ep_trial >= 60 raises precision from 0.23 to 0.56 at about the same recall (dev F1 0.69, mass recall 0.91). Most misses are rel -3 D1 steps, where the previous trial is outside the window, so the predicate cannot be evaluated there; they are probably the same event. Many matching steps stay silent, and none of these explains them: the hidden good state, value, or the upcoming choice of the agent (action == 1 gives precision 0.77 but cuts recall to 0.62). Active steps have a mid-range value (5.2-7.1) and a near-neutral policy logit. Magnitude (mean 0.32, max 0.70) did not clearly track any variable I checked. Uses only observed variables.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
